description: A multiplex networked agent-based simulation calibrated on the first 30 days of data to predict individual mask-wearing behavior for days 30–39. Agents update daily via a calibrated logistic adoption rule with persistence, layer-specific peer influence, exogenous information effects, and policy/campaign influences. The social network is symmetrized with family, work/school, and community layers.

behaviors.name: observe_neighbors
behaviors.description: Agents observe each network layer to estimate the fraction of neighbors wearing masks and perceived norms.
behaviors.algorithm: For each layer l in {family, work_school, community}: peer_frac_{i,l}(t-1) = (# neighbors wearing at t-1) / (degree_l + epsilon). Apply Gaussian noise N(0, observation_noise) then clamp to [0,1].

behaviors.name: update_perceived_norm
behaviors.description: Compute a memory-weighted perceived norm combining recent exposures.
behaviors.algorithm: Norm_i(t) = sum_{k=1..M} [exp(-decay_lambda*(k-1)) * WeightedPeerFrac_i(t-k)] / sum_{k=1..M} exp(-decay_lambda*(k-1)), where WeightedPeerFrac uses layer_weights.

behaviors.name: decide_adopt_or_drop_mask
behaviors.description: Daily update of mask-wearing via logistic adoption with persistence and dropout.
behaviors.algorithm: Let x_i(t) = beta0 + beta_persist*wear_i(t-1) + beta_info*info_i(t) + beta_risk*risk_i + beta_peer_family*peer_frac_family_i(t-1) + beta_peer_work*peer_frac_work_i(t-1) + beta_peer_comm*peer_frac_comm_i(t-1) + beta_policy*Policy_t + beta_normcue*Norm_i(t-1). p_i(t) = sigmoid(x_i(t)). Sample wear_i(t) ~ Bernoulli(p_i(t)). If wear_i(t-1)=1 and wear_i(t)=1, optionally apply dropout with prob p_drop (overrides to 0 with that probability) modulated by fatigue: p_drop_eff = min(1, dropout_probability + fatigue_rate * days_since_adopt).

behaviors.name: share_information_or_misinformation
behaviors.description: Exogenous and social information exposure events increase short-term adoption propensity.
behaviors.algorithm: Pr(info_i(t)=1) = info_arrival_prob_base + social_info_boost * WeightedPeerFrac_i(t-1). If info_i(t)=1 then set received_info_state=1 and last_info_day=t. For k days after last_info_day, add beta_info*exp(-ln(2)*k/info_effect_half_life_days) to x_i(t). Misinformation events (rate) subtract a fraction of beta_info and reduce trust_in_authorities.

behaviors.name: respond_to_policy_enforcement
behaviors.description: Location policies enforce compliance and shift norms starting Day 10.
behaviors.algorithm: If t >= policy_start_day and agent enters a Location with mask_policy=on: temporarily override wear_i(t)=1 with probability proportional to enforcement_strength, and add a policy term Policy_t=1 to x_i(t). Also adjust perceived norm upward by signage_or_cue_level.

behaviors.name: broadcast_message
behaviors.description: Organizations broadcast pro-mask messages increasing info exposure starting Day 30.
behaviors.algorithm: For t in [campaign_start_day, campaign_end_day], select target agents by targeting_strategy. For each targeted agent, set info_i(t)=1 with probability proportional to campaign_intensity*credibility and agent trust_in_authorities.

interactions.name: peer_influence_diffusion
interactions.description: Agents update adoption via layer-weighted peer fractions observed on the previous day.
interactions.effect: Modifies adoption probability via beta_peer_{layer} terms in the logistic equation.

interactions.name: social_reinforcement_and_sanctions
interactions.description: Repeated exposures and normative cues increase adoption propensity; fatigue may increase dropout.

interactions.name: organizational_broadcast
interactions.description: Campaign messages increase likelihood of info exposure and raise perceived risk for trusting agents.
interactions.effect: Increases info_i(t) and temporarily increases x_i(t) via the info effect term.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates at locations enforce immediate compliance and shift longer-term norms.
interactions.effect: Immediate mask_wearing_state may be set to 1 with some probability; Policy_t term increases adoption propensity.

interactions.name: misinformation_propagation
interactions.description: Negative messaging reduces adoption propensity and trust in authorities.
interactions.effect: Subtracts from info effect and reduces future responsiveness to authority-driven messages.

interactions.name: tie_dynamics
interactions.description: Optional: edges can be rewired based on homophily and norm conflict; disabled for prediction window.
interactions.effect: Rewires edges and updates degree distribution (off by default for days 0–39).

steps: Load agent_attributes.csv; cast ids to int; normalize risk_perception to [0,1].
Load social_network.json; build three undirected graphs; remove self-loops; deduplicate edges; compute degrees per layer.
Load train_data.csv; sort by (agent_id, day); ensure complete days 0..29; cast wearing_mask/received_info to {0,1}.
Compute peer fractions by layer at t-1 for days 1..29 using network and wearing_mask.
Estimate logistic coefficients and dropout from days 0..29.
Initialize agent states at day 29 (end of train) to use as starting point for day 30 prediction.
Set policy parameters active from day 10; set campaign schedule from day 30.

algorithms.CALIBRATE_LOGISTIC: Fit a discrete-time logistic regression (GLMM optional) of wearing_mask_t ~ wear_{t-1} + received_info_t + risk_perception + peer_frac_family_{t-1} + peer_frac_work_{t-1} + peer_frac_comm_{t-1} + Policy_t + Norm_{t-1} + subgroup fixed effects. Use statsmodels or sklearn. Extract coefficients as betas.
algorithms.ESTIMATE_DROPOUT: Compute p_drop = mean(wear_t=0 | wear_{t-1}=1) over days 1..29; optionally stratify and average.
algorithms.COMPUTE_LAYER_EXPOSURES: For each agent and day, peer_frac_{layer}(t-1) = count_neighbors_wearing(t-1)/degree_{layer}. Handle degree=0 by setting fraction=0.
algorithms.SIMULATE_DAY: Synchronous update. For each agent: observe_neighbors -> update_perceived_norm -> compute info_i(t) -> compute x_i(t) from coefficients and inputs -> draw wear_i(t) ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(x_i(t))); apply policy enforcement if active; apply dropout/fatigue if persisted wearing.
algorithms.POLICY_BROADCAST: If day >= policy_start_day, set Policy_t=1 for relevant locations; adjust enforcement-induced immediate wearing with probability enforcement_strength.
algorithms.ORG_BROADCAST: If campaign_start_day <= day <= campaign_end_day, for target agents set info_i(t)=1 with probability proportional to campaign_intensity*credibility*trust_in_authorities.
algorithms.RMSE_OVER_PREDICTION_DAYS: Aggregate predicted adoption rate per day r_hat(t) over days 30..39; compare with actual r(t) from train_data.csv if available; RMSE = sqrt(mean((r_hat(t) - r(t))^2)).

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent demographics and risk perception; compute subgroup effects.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Construct multiplex network and compute layer-specific peer exposures.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate behavior model on days 0..29; initialize states; validate predictions.

files.name: config.yaml
files.description: Holds parameters, file paths, and toggles for calibration/prediction.

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Load and validate CSV/JSON, cast types, handle missing days, and join keys.

files.name: network_builder.py
files.description: Build symmetrized multiplex graphs per layer; compute degrees and layer weights.

files.name: features.py
files.description: Compute peer fractions by layer, perceived norms, policy flags, and info features.

files.name: calibration/calibrate.py
files.description: Fit logistic model and dropout; serialize coefficients.

files.name: models/adoption_model.py
files.description: Implements logistic adoption, info decay, and dropout/fatigue mechanisms.

files.name: simulation/entities.py
files.description: Defines Person, Location, Organization, Environment classes with behaviors.

files.name: simulation/engine.py
files.description: Main simulation loop (synchronous updates) and interaction orchestration.

files.name: evaluation/metrics.py
files.description: Compute RMSE and other optional metrics over prediction days.

files.name: prediction/predict.py
files.description: Run calibrated simulation for days 30..39 and write per-agent and aggregate predictions.

files.description: CLI entry point to run calibration, simulation, and evaluation.
